## 席位核对 · Amendment · 2026-11-03T02:16Z · surface for #29693

Measured live in the card thread at about 1024 px with the right panel open (head `511875ee`): folding the chips and the five tool icons into the more menu makes the Interfaces report leaf whole (工时按状态分布, 125 px), but the flow header still reads "Notify on…" (100 of 221 px), because the Customize button (78 px) and the ledger switch label (本部署中已开启, about 130 px) keep their text.

**Plan approved:** a second fold stage in `StudioItemHeader`. After the chips and tools have folded, and before the title gives up its minimum, labelled header actions go icon-only. The label stays the accessible name and the tooltip.

**Surface, amended.** Added to the claim's surface:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` (the Customize button's label wrap)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/FlowLedgerSwitch.tsx` (the ledger switch's label wrap)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/item-tools/StudioItemTools.tsx` (tools hand their menu form to the header)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx` (the flow more menu mounts the folded items)

**Conditions on delivery.**

- Customize keeps the primary slot when it goes icon-only; it does not move into the more menu.
- A folded item works from the more menu exactly as it did in the row, including the override chip's text. Seat 4's #29692 puts a popover with Restore package original on that chip after this lands, so a folded chip must stay one reachable menu entry, not plain text lost in the fold.
- Pins: the fold order (chips and tools, then labels, then the title's minimum), and for each folded item that its menu entry fires the same action. The accessible name of each icon-only action equals its label.
- Before and after screenshots at about 1024 px with the right panel open, for every pillar (Interfaces, flow, object, dashboard, report, view), under `/mnt/project-files/issue-29693/`, named in the body.
- The body says where #29691's 保存到 … 的定制 sentence goes in the header (seat 1 adds it after this lands).
- Stay out of `addedFieldName` and `addedExtensionFieldName` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: #29690 changes those. Whichever of the two lands second merges `main` first.

## 席位核对 · Amendment · 2026-11-03T03:54Z · one live spec for #29693

Adds `ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` to the surface of amendment 6593712299.

**Why.** Live E2E UI went red on `205c4531` (job 125715096807). The spec asserts at L137 that `studio-override-chip` is visible in the header row after the pair is published. At the job's 1280×720 viewport, with the Interfaces inspector open, the row now folds stage 1 and the chip moves into the ⋯ menu's `studio-item-header-folded-chips` entry. That is the behaviour the card asks for.

**What the edit may do.** At that one assertion, accept the chip in either place:

- If the chip is in the row, the assertion stays as it is.
- Otherwise, open `if-item-more` and expect `studio-override-chip` to be visible inside `studio-item-header-folded-chips`.
- Then close the menu, so the next step opens a fresh one.

The invariant stays the same: after publish, the override chip is reachable from the header. Nothing else in the spec changes, and no assertion is removed or loosened beyond that one either-or.

**Condition.** Run the spec locally against the showcase backend before you push, and put the run's result in the PR body. Keeping the chip pinned in the row was weighed and rejected, because it costs the title the room the card asks for.
